dct_description_sm: This dataset contains recordings from the Rogers Pass weather station, located in Glacier National Park, B.-C., Canada. It is divided into two subdatasets; an hourly dataset, and a 10 minutes based dataset. The weather station is maintained by Parks Canada staff multiple time weekly during the winter. Note that the station is used primarily for winter avalanche forecasting; thus station maintenance is primarily done over the winter. However, the station is also maintained once a week during the summer. For more details, please refer to the “Data & File Overview” section in the README. The name of each file provide insight on if the data is a hourly or 10 minutes recording, and the date provide the first and last recording of each file.
